brand.name: VITALNEX
brand.disclaimer: VITALNEX is a research and decision-support prototype. It does not diagnose disease, prescribe treatment, or replace a qualified healthcare professional.

hero.title: Your health. Your intelligence. Your care — connected.
hero.subtitle: A human-centered clinical AI ecosystem combining transparent risk assessment, verifiable AI Trust Passports, and connected regional care.

dashboard.subtitle: Here is your health and clinical screening overview.
dashboard.completenessText: Complete your health profile to unlock higher clinical confidence.
dashboard.emptyAssessmentDesc: Input your clinical and lifestyle parameters to generate your transparent risk profile.

risk.title: Clinical Risk Screening
risk.subtitle: Screening for diabetes, heart disease and stroke. This is not a diagnosis.

care.title: Care Connect
care.subtitle: Transparent doctor discovery across Pune and regional healthcare hubs.
care.verifiedNotice: Demo clinician profile (not a real doctor)
care.noSlots: This demo doctor has no free slots in the next 14 days.

assistant.title: AI Health Intelligence Assistant
assistant.subtitle: Ask questions regarding your health metrics, screening report, or care guidance.
assistant.placeholder: Ask about your health indicators, risk score, or doctor booking...
assistant.prompt2: What does my risk assessment mean?
assistant.prompt3: Help me find a cardiologist in Pune
assistant.emergencyBanner: If experiencing severe chest pain, shortness of breath, or emergency symptoms, immediately call 108 / 112.

voice.title: Voice & Multilingual Accessibility
voice.subtitle: Interact with VITALNEX using voice navigation, speech synthesis, and accessible controls.

onboarding.title: Welcome to VITALNEX
onboarding.privacyBadge: Your data is strictly encrypted and protected by Row Level Security.

status.notInMvpBody: This feature is under development and is not part of the current version of VITALNEX.
status.assessmentUnavailableBody: VITALNEX is being rebuilt on real survey data. The risk screening will return once the new models are trained and reviewed. Until then no scores are shown. If you have symptoms such as chest pain, call 108 / 112.
status.noAssessmentBody: Your screening results will appear here once the screening is available and you have completed it.
status.trustUnavailableBody: The Trust Passport will be generated from the real model cards once the new models are trained. No metrics are shown until then.
status.noDataBody: Nothing has been recorded yet. Real figures will appear here once they exist.
status.profileRebuildBody: The old profile asked for lab and test values that most people do not know, and filled in default values when you left them blank. It is being replaced by a short set of questions you can answer yourself.

auth.notConfigured: Sign-in is not available: Supabase is not configured for this app.
auth.noProfile: This account has no VITALNEX profile.
auth.demoNotice: MVP with dummy accounts only. Do not enter real personal health information.
auth.roleNotice: Your access depends on your account, not on the portal you choose.
auth.signupSubtitle: Clinician and admin accounts are created by the VITALNEX team.
auth.checkEmail: Check your email to confirm your account, then sign in.
auth.signupNoHealthData: No health information is collected when you create an account.
auth.forgotSubtitle: We will email you a link to set a new password.
auth.resetSent: If an account exists for this email, a reset link has been sent.
auth.passwordsDiffer: The two passwords do not match.
auth.passwordUpdated: Password updated. You can now sign in.
auth.resetLinkInvalid: This reset link is invalid or has expired. Request a new one.

reviewQueue.title: Clinician review queue
reviewQueue.subtitle: Results from patients who agreed to share with clinicians.
reviewQueue.emptyBody: A result appears here when a consenting patient's screening is High, not confident, flagged for data quality, or an emergency.
reviewQueue.loadFailed: Could not load the review queue.
reviewQueue.actionsUnavailable: Agree / override actions are not available yet.
